subject.title: fix: order ambient transcript watermarks by decimal ids

question: For equal timestamps that mix canonical decimal IDs with opaque IDs, should the watermark preserve a replay-safe monotonic decimal boundary or treat arrival order as authoritative?
rationale: A single stored message ID cannot infer a total order across incomparable ID formats, and the selected policy changes persisted replay boundaries for existing sessions.

options.title: Require monotonic replay semantics
options.body: Do not replace a comparable decimal boundary with an opaque ID unless the representation has a stable ordering rule that prevents later lower decimal IDs from being accepted.

options.title: Adopt arrival-order semantics
options.body: Allow every distinct opaque or mixed-format ID to advance the watermark, but explicitly accept and document that replay ordering depends on observed arrival order.

recommendation.title: Require monotonic replay semantics
recommendation.body: Do not replace a comparable decimal boundary with an opaque ID unless the representation has a stable ordering rule that prevents later lower decimal IDs from being accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only supplied participant with a direct follow-up signal on the original review and are the best available owner for the semantic choice.
